summary: Rolling out PIM Activator is now a guided page with buttons that do the work for you.

new.title: PIM Activator page as guided steps
new.text: Operations > PIM Activator now has five steps, from the Entra apps to servers, each showing whether it is done.

new.title: Create apps and upload to Intune
new.text: Create / Repair and Upload to Intune work right from the page. You sign in with your own admin account; PIM Manager itself gets no new rights.

new.title: Edge for Business guide
new.text: One card per extension shows exactly the fields the Microsoft 365 admin center asks for, plus the two settings to paste.

new.title: Edit button for external companies
new.text: A company reads as text until you click Edit; a new company opens ready to fill in.

fixes.title: Mail works when addresses differ
fixes.text: Mail sender setup now stores the mailbox's real mail address, so mail no longer fails when its sign-in name and mail address differ.

fixes.title: Drift Delete confirms itself
fixes.text: After Delete the row reads "queued for removal", and the same item is never queued twice.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: PIM Activator scripts need no extra PowerShell modules, and "Delegations - edit in a table" is now called "Delegations - all rows".
